case.validNote: pool level and outflow comparable with the model up to validTo; the wall data run to the end, with more water in the bowl than the model after validTo
case.wallClockNote: the Mac was asleep for about 5,025 s during the run (from the solver log: clock time running far ahead of computing time); wallClock_s and solver_s leave that out, wallClockRaw_s keeps it

wetRule: wall face wet when alpha.water > 0.5; model cell wet when more than half of its wall faces are wet; same rule at every sample (0.05 s); shares area-weighted with model cell areas
